description: Invites people by email to a list the signed-in shopper owns, as viewers (default) or editors, and returns the list's share link when the list has one. Each address gets an invitation email from Plendio in the shopper's name, which cannot be recalled once sent, so the addresses and the role are best confirmed with the shopper first. At most 10 addresses per request and 20 people per list; invitations are rate-limited. Requires sign-in.

market.description: Market for the links in the answer: dk, se, de or no.

role.description: viewer (default) can see the list; editor can also add and remove products.

name: share_wishlist
title: Share my list by email
